summaryShort: There's attraction here, but it can come with a little friction around affection, taste, or feeling appreciated. One person's natural style may not quite match how the other person likes to give or receive warmth, so the fondness is real but slightly out of step.
summaryDeep:
There's attraction here, but it can come with a little friction around affection, taste, or feeling appreciated. One person's natural style may not quite match how the other person likes to give or receive warmth, so the fondness is real but slightly out of step.

It often shows up in small ways. One person shows they care in a way the other doesn't fully register. Compliments land oddly. Gestures get misread. Nobody's being cold; the affection just keeps arriving in the wrong key.

The trap is reading the mismatch as a lack of caring. The feeling may be there, but the delivery keeps getting crossed.

Say what actually makes you feel appreciated instead of waiting to receive it the way you'd give it. This one smooths out when both people stop expecting love to arrive in their exact language.
